sketch:
Observe: SVG schematic with a variable DC generator E, switch, and a
component slot for a passive receiver (resistor, capacitor, or coil —
dropdown selector). Voltmeter across receiver, ammeter in series. For
resistor: linear U(I) plot builds up as E is swept. For capacitor:
current spike then decay (steady-state I=0 in DC). For coil: initial
transient then steady I = E/r. Sliders: E, R (or C, or L).
Experiment: identify the mystery component from its U(I) trace by
matching a target curve. Evaluate: component label hidden; student
proposes which type it is based on characteristic shape. Wrinkle:
keeps DC steady-state for resistor (main 2ème focus); capacitor/coil
transients hinted, not derived.
